plugins.name: phased-execution
plugins.description: Run large work as a dependency graph of right-sized Claude sessions — plans, per-phase handoffs, and a computed ready-set. Ships a zero-dependency local web console: one install serves every project, each repository getting its own console, port, state and supervisor from a single `cd <project> && phase-console start` — list them, open one by name, and drive any of them with the same verbs. Its autopilot heals its own runs: a halt an agent can clear launches a bounded recovery session by itself, and when the board reads fixed the run record moves with it and carries on, so one press either finishes the plan or parks it on something only a person can do, named. Gates are categorized by who can clear them: an ai gate is the booted session's first task (verify the conditions, do the work, record the clearance, continue) while a human gate carries numbered operator steps beside an Approve button on the phase page — one approval clears a gate of any kind and can resume the run it parked. Register many Claude accounts and watch their real usage meters — a run switches accounts at a limit, or waits out the window and resumes itself. Name the MCP servers a plan needs and the console proves them before a run spends anything: a server that was never signed in parks the phase at boarding, rather than letting an unattended session improvise around missing tools for an hour, and the parked phase requeues itself the moment you sign in. A session now declares how it ended rather than leaving the runner to read prose: a phase waiting on an external clock — a CI image build, a deploy window, a PR merging itself — parks with its window and its watch refs and resumes its own session when the window elapses, a lock another plan holds queues behind the named holder instead of parking forever, and a record the board has already overtaken closes itself instead of being re-run. Plus scope-aware concurrency so disjoint plans run at once while intersecting phases queue, per-session freeze/continue/stop, closable plans that stop reporting work nobody will do, per-session tabs, remaining-time estimates, a plan-mode wizard that drafts a plan before writing it, and Tailscale onboarding to drive it all from your phone. The console also installs prebuilt via npm (phase-console) or Homebrew (zsarir/homebrew-tap/phase-console).
